notifications.title: Setup needed
notifications.body: No feed endpoint configured. See the README: set ENDPOINT in src/main.ts and add its origin to app.json's network whitelist, then rebuild.

notifications.title: A notification
notifications.body: Notifications are flat: a category, a title and a body. The app renders whatever it finds, newest first.
